acceptanceCriteria: Each provider plan execution retains a receipt bound to the plan digest
Application markers observed under the provider are recorded in that receipt
Tests prove a missing or mismatched marker reads INCOMPLETE, not complete
body: Found by the V1-2011 lane (PR #1285, head 17e98b009, BBF-V0-019..028). The provider plan is executed without its own retained evidence receipt, and application markers (what the provider actually started) are not recorded under the provider. Expected: each provider plan step emits a receipt that names the plan digest and the observed application markers so a reviewer can confirm the plan that ran. Actual: only the overall falsification receipt is retained.
title: Falsification: evidence receipts for provider plans and application markers under the provider
